title: Soft delete vs purge
text:
Symptom / ask: Accidental delete destroyed media or registry state.
Cause: Immediate purge as the default delete path.
Do: Default to same-filesystem soft trash with retention; require explicit purge for permanent delete.
Don't: Make irreversible delete the one-click default for user libraries.
Pointer: library/apps with user media or registries.

title: Stable IDs from normalized paths
text:
Symptom / ask: Renaming a display title or re-scan breaks links, progress, or cache keys.
Cause: IDs derived from mutable labels instead of stable location identity.
Do: Use a stable hash/id of a normalized absolute path (or other immutable key); keep display names separate.
Don't: Key caches/progress on folder basename alone if the folder can move or be retitled.
Pointer: media libraries, asset registries, local indexes.
